subject: Learning Methods
title: When to Let Notes Go
description: Learn When to Let Notes Go in one minute.

hook.text: She had notes from five years ago that she kept reviewing. Most were for a job she no longer held. Dead weight.

buildup.text: Note systems grow without end. Without pruning, outdated and irrelevant notes dilute the valuable ones.

discovery.text: Archiving, not deleting, lets you move inactive notes out of your active system while preserving them just in case.

twist.text: The fear of losing information makes people hoard notes. But clutter has a real cost: it slows search and clouds.

climax.text: Quarterly, review your note system. Archive anything you haven't touched in six months. Keep your active system lean.

punchline.text: Archive the old. Keep the active system sharp and lean.

quiz.question: What is the recommended approach for outdated notes?
options: Delete them permanently to free up space
Archive them out of the active system while preserving them
Keep them active since old information may become relevant
